decision.reason: Scaleway primary press release confirms Oct 13 AMD MI355X/ROCm cloud deployment in Sweden; infrastructure engineers comparing Nvidia/CUDA portability now face hardware/software compatibility and economic evidence tracking.
decision.article_title: «On sort de notre dépendance à Nvidia sur les GPU» : Scaleway devient le premier acteur du cloud à commercialiser en Europe de la puissance de calcul basée sur les cartes graphiques d’AMD - L'Usine Nouvelle

opportunities.core_job: Compare workload's library support, build/reproducibility, observed performance and cost against AMD ROCm or Nvidia CUDA hardware
opportunities.target_customer: European enterprise cloud/AI infrastructure architects and finance reviewers
opportunities.product_mechanism: Manually entered dependency/driver/ROCm-CUDA matrix → provider configuration → acceptance/performance CSV → migration issue and sign-off
opportunities.why_now: Scaleway announced first Swedish AMD MI355X cloud supercomputer and expanded European GPU vendor choices on Oct.13
opportunities.before_state: Vendor switching involves undocumented runtime/kernel/library compatibility and price assumptions
opportunities.after_state: Portable evidence matrix and human-reviewed pilot test criteria without connecting to GPUs or paid API

source_observations.observation: Scaleway first-party announcement specifies AMD MI355X GPUs and ROCm ecosystem, commercial offering for European companies.
